title: Conversion of Storm Shelter into Public Convenience Facilities and Refurbishment of Accessible Toilet Accommodation, Blenheim Gardens, Minehead
description: Minehead Town Council invites suitably qualified and experienced contractors to submit tenders for the conversion of the former storm shelter within Blenheim Gardens, Minehead into modern public convenience facilities together with the refurbishment and conversion of a separate toilet building within the gardens to provide fully accessible toilet accommodation and associated storage facilities. The site occupies a prominent position within Blenheim Gardens, Minehead's principal public open space, and lies within the Wellington Square Conservation Area. The Council wishes to deliver attractive, durable, accessible and vandal-resistant facilities whilst preserving the architectural character and appearance of the existing buildings. The works comprise the alteration, refurbishment and fit out of two existing buildings. The former storm shelter will be converted to provide male and female public toilet accommodation, baby changing facilities and associated handwashing facilities. A separate building within the gardens will be refurbished to provide a fully accessible toilet facility together with independent storage accommodation. The project includes, but is not limited to, demolition and alteration works, drainage works, utility connections, plumbing and sanitary installations, electrical installations, ventilation systems, roofing replacement and repairs, internal finishes, accessibility improvements, external repairs, testing, commissioning and all associated works necessary to provide fully operational public convenience facilities. The successful contractor will be responsible for providing all labour, materials, plant, supervision and specialist subcontractors required to complete the works. Responsibilities will include project management, utility provider liaison, Building Regulations compliance, testing, commissioning, certification and handover. Particular emphasis is placed upon durability, long-term maintainability, accessibility and resistance to vandalism. Materials, fixtures, fittings and finishes must be suitable for intensive public use and capable of withstanding a coastal environment exposed to wind-driven rain, salt-laden air and high seasonal visitor numbers. Tenderers shall demonstrate relevant experience in the successful delivery of comparable construction and refurbishment projects and provide evidence of their ability to meet programme requirements. The completed facilities must be fully operational and available for public use no later than 1 March 2027. The Council reserves the right not to accept the lowest or any tender received and reserves the right to amend, suspend, abandon or recommence the procurement process at any stage.

title: CA18544 - Well-Led Review of Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS Trust
description: Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS Trust (AWP) provides mental health services across Bath and North East Somerset, Bristol, North Somerset, South Gloucestershire, Swindon and Wiltshire, from more than 90 community and inpatient sites and through partnerships with external organisations. Services include acute mental health, recovery, liaison and dementia services, forensic services, Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services and a range of highly specialist mental health services. AWP is currently in segment 3 of the NHS Oversight Framework and rated Amber-Green under the Provider Capability assessment. Following a Care Quality Commission inspection in 2024, reported in May 2025, the Trust's well-led rating was 'requires improvement'. AWP operates across two financially challenged Integrated Care Systems and works with the South West Provider Collaborative for mental health services. The Board has invested in strengthening external stakeholder relationships and reviewing partnership working models. It has also experienced material membership changes since the previous well-led inspection, including a new Chair in autumn 2024 and three new Non-Executive Directors commencing in 2026. AWP now requires an independent, developmental review of leadership and governance against the Care Quality Commission well-led framework. The review will provide objective and constructive challenge, identify prioritised developmental actions and inform targeted improvement work to secure and sustain future performance. title: CA18541 - DN Colleges Group - Learner Finder Services Preferred Supplier ITT
description: DN Colleges Group (DNCG) invites tenders from suitably qualified and experienced organisations for appointment to a Learner Finder Preferred Supplier List (PSL). The requirement primarily concerns identifying, engaging and recruiting eligible learners for Adult Skills Funded provision across South Yorkshire and Greater Lincolnshire, including online and distance-learning courses. Services will include learner recruitment, initial advice and guidance, eligibility checks, enrolment support, controlled learner handovers and performance reporting. The arrangement also provides scope for additional learner recruitment services relating to classroom-based Adult Skills, Higher Education and 16-19 provision, where offered by the successful suppliers. DNCG intends to appoint up to three suppliers, ranked following a competitive evaluation. The highest-ranked supplier will ordinarily receive the first opportunity to fulfil requirements, with any unmet demand cascading to the next-ranked supplier in accordance with the published arrangements. The contract will operate for an initial three-year period, with options to extend for two further 12-month periods (3 + 1 + 1). Pricing will be based on agreed fees per eligible learner. No minimum expenditure or learner volumes are guaranteed. The full specification, evaluation methodology, contract terms and tender return requirements are contained within the procurement documentation. title: Peatland ACTION FW02 Field Ecologists Framework
description: NatureScot work to improve our natural environment in Scotland and inspire everyone to care more about it. We work to ensure that all nature in Scotland - our key habitats and landscapes, all our green space and our native species - are maintained, enhanced and bring us benefits. Our priority is a nature-rich future for Scotland and an effective response to the climate emergency. title: Stonehaven Promenade Improvement Works
description: Aberdeenshire Council are inviting tenders for Stonehaven Promenade Improvement works. Aberdeenshire Council require a Contractor to construct the Works which will involve widening the existing pavements to create a safer active travel route for pedestrians and wheelchair users to access the recreational/leisure facilities. New crossing points will be created and raised to pavement levels to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users in crossing from one side of the road to the other. The plans also include designing and installing new parapet barriers along the seafront and resurfacing works to the Promenade.

We work to ensure that all nature in Scotland - our key habitats and landscapes, all our green space and our native species - are maintained, enhanced and bring us benefits. Our priority is a nature-rich future for Scotland and an effective response to the climate emergency. Peatland ACTION funding - from Scottish Government - primarily supports on-the-ground peatland restoration activities and is open for applications from eligible land managers who have peatlands that would benefit from restoration. There are no geographical restrictions or target areas for Peatland ACTION funding. Peatlands are an iconic part of the Scottish landscape and have many benefits for people and nature. Healthy peatlands provide important ecosystem services including storing and sequestering carbon, supporting unique and specialised biodiversity, improving downstream water quality, and regulating water flow to provide natural flood management. In contrast, damage to peatlands reduces or reverses these benefits. For example, degraded peatlands release stored carbon and are a major global source of greenhouse gas emissions. Peatland ACTION is led and funded by Scottish Government and delivered in partnership with NatureScot, Cairngorms National Park Authority, Loch Lomond & the Trossachs National Park Authority, Forestry and Land Scotland, and Scottish Water. Since 2012, Peatland ACTION has set over 66,000 hectares of degraded peatland on the road to recovery, but this effort needs to accelerate rapidly in the coming years to help address the twin crises of the climate emergency and biodiversity loss. The appointed Field Ecologists will work with the Peatland ACTION Technical Team and Project Officers located across Scotland to help support species and ecological survey requirements for Peatland ACTION restoration sites.

title: Germany – Rural areas mapping services – Kartierung Monitoring und Risikomanagement - StDeOe.7022 Amphibien, StDeOe.7023 Offenlandvogelarten, StDeOe.7024 Vegetation, StDeOe.7025 Phengaris
description: Los 1 - StDeOe.7022 Amphibien: Im Zuge des Donauausbaus Straubing – Vilshofen, Teilabschnitt 1, Straubing – Deggendorf, wird ein Monitoring und Risikomanagement für LBP-Maßnahmen durchgeführt. In diesem Zusammenhang müssen Daten zum Besiedlungserfolg von Amphibien sowie zur Entwicklung der zugehörigen LBP-Maßnahmenflächen erhoben werden. Es handelt sich hierbei um die Arten Knoblauchkröte (Pelobates fuscus) und Laubfrosch (Hyla arborea). Die Vertragslaufzeit erstreckt sich von Januar 2027 – November 2028. Im Rahmen dieser Arbeiten sind die Ergebnisse digital aufzubereiten und ein Erläuterungsbericht sowie eine Fotodokumentation zu erstellen. Los 2 - StDeOe.7023 Offenlandvogelarten: Im Zuge des Donauausbaus Straubing – Vilshofen, Teilabschnitt 1, Straubing – Deggendorf, wird ein Monitoring und Risikomanagement für ausgewählte LBP-Maßnahmen durchgeführt. In diesem Zusammenhang muss 2027 eine Revierkartierungen zur aktuellen Bestandssituation der Offenlandvogelarten Kiebitz (Vanellus vanellus) und Großer Brachvogel (Numenius arquata) durchgeführt werden. Die Vertragslaufzeit erstreckt sich von Februar bis Oktober 2027. Im Rahmen dieser Arbeiten sind die Ergebnisse digital aufzubereiten und ein Erläuterungsbericht sowie eine Fotodokumentation zu erstellen. Los 3 - StDeOe.7024 Vegetation: Im Zuge des Planfeststellungsverfahrens Donauausbau Straubing – Vilshofen, Teilabschnitt 1, Straubing – Deggendorf, wird ein Monitoring und Risikomanagement für ausgewählte LBP-Maßnahmen durchgeführt. Dieses Monitoring ist aufgegliedert in ein vegetationsbezogenes Monitoring und ein maßnahmenbezogenes Monitoring. Im Zusammenhang des vegetationsbezogenen Monitorings müssen Biotop- und Nutzungstypen, sowie FFH-Kartierungen inkl. Bewertung für die Lebensraumtypen 91E0*, 91F0, 9170 und 6210 durchgeführt werden. Außerdem erfolgt eine Kartierung der Art Lindernia procumbens sowie Arten der Teichried-, Teichboden und Zwergbinsengesellschaften. Im Rahmen des maßnahmenbezogenen Monitorings sind vegetationsökologische Untersuchungen zu, Gehölzaufwuchs, Baumartenzusammensetzung und Störzeiger, sowie weitere standörtliche Erfassungen durchzuführen. Des Weiteren erfolgen bodenkundliche Kartierungen (Fingerprobe) verschiedener LBP-Maßnahmenflächen. Die Vertragslaufzeit erstreckt sich von 2027 bis 2028. Im Rahmen dieser Arbeiten sind die Ergebnisse jährlich digital aufzubereiten und ein Erläuterungsbericht sowie eine Fotodokumentation zu erstellen. Los 4 - StDeOe.7025 Phengaris: Im Zuge des Planfeststellungsverfahrens Donauausbau Straubing – Vilshofen, Teil-abschnitt 1, Straubing – Deggendorf, wird ein Monitoring und Risikomanagement für ausgewählte LBP-Maßnahmen durchgeführt. In diesem Zusammenhang müssen Daten zur aktuellen Bestandssituation des Dunklen Wiesenknopf-Ameisenbläulings (Phengaris nausithous) auf Referenzflächen sowie zur Entwicklung von LBP-Maßnahmenflächen erhoben werden. Im Rahmen dieser Arbeiten sind die Ergebnisse digital aufzubereiten und ein Erläuterungsbericht sowie eine Fotodokumentation zu erstellen.

title: Thermal releases: Review of international regulatory practices and options for incorporation into a compliance and licensing framework.
description: Please return offers by email to solicitation-demandedesoumission@cnsc-ccsn.gc.ca Canada is seeking offers from qualified Offerors to provide professional services to review if and how thermal risk assessments (TRAs) are being conducted across the electrical power generation industry domestically and internationally, and if there are any existing regulatory frameworks addressing management of thermal effluent. The work will identify gaps in the standardized application of TRA methods and provide recommendations where applicable for improvement in standardization of TRAs for the nuclear power plants in Canada. The scope includes a critical evaluation of thermal effects literature for reliability and relevance for being able to inform a TRA, and the generation of an updated database of thermal effects thresholds for Canadian relevant species fish, and invertebrate species in the marine and freshwater environment. The scope of this project also includes reviewing and compiling data on regulatory approaches used by different facilities utilizing once-through cooling system technology (e.g., nuclear power plants, oil and gas plants, etc.), nationally and internationally, with respect to thermal risk assessment and the derivation and application of thermal thresholds.

title: Evaluering av tilskuddsordninger for nasjonale minoriteters språk og kultur
description: Kulturdirektoratet forvalter fem tilskuddsordninger for å styrke nasjonale minoriteters språk, kultur, identitet og egenorganisering. De nasjonale minoritetene i Norge er kvener/norskfinner, skogfinner, romanifolk/tatere, romer og jøder. Ordningene er sentrale virkemidler for aktiv samfunnsdeltakelse og styrking av språk og kultur. På oppdrag fra Kommunal- og distriktsdepartementet lyser Kulturdirektoratet nå ut en ekstern evaluering av disse ordningene. Formålet med evalueringen er å få kunnskap om hvorvidt, i hvilken grad og på hvilken måte tilskuddsordningene bidrar til å oppfylle målene som er satt og hvordan de eventuelt kan videreutvikles for bedre å styrke nasjonale minoriteters språk og kultur. Oppdragstaker skal vurdere om ordningene er effektive med hensyn til ressursbruk, organisering og måloppnåelse.

title: Infrarakentamisen valvonnan ja tilannekuvan sovelluksen hankinta
description: Infrarakentamisen valvonnan ja tilannekuvan sovelluksen hankinta Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala (KYMP) on toteuttamassa Infrarakentamisen valvonnan ja tilannekuvan sovelluksen hankintaa. Järjestelmä hankitaan ohjelmistopalveluna (SaaS). Sillä tuetaan katujen, puistojen ja muiden yleisten alueiden infrahankkeiden seurantaa valmistelusta takuuajan päättymiseen, erityisesti urakan toteutusvaiheen hallintaa, dokumentointia ja viestintää kenttäolosuhteissa. Järjestelmää käyttävät kaupungin rakennuttajat ja suunnittelijat sekä urakoitsijat ja suunnittelu- ja valvontakonsultit. Käyttäjiä on tavoitetilassa noin 400, ja urakkavaiheessa olevia hankkeita on vuosittain noin 200. Hankinta sisältää ohjelmistopalvelun käyttöoikeudet, ylläpidon ja tuen sekä kiinteähintaisen käyttöönottoprojektin. Ohjelmistopalvelu on toimitettava lopulliseen hyväksymistestaukseen viimeistään 12 kuukauden kuluttua sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta. Lisäksi hankinta sisältää tarvittaessa erikseen tilattavia koulutus-, jatkokehitys- ja asiantuntijapalveluja. Sopimus on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankinnan tausta ja kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus.,

title: Transformation d’un terrain de football naturel en synthétique
description: La commune de Veyrier a décidé de transformer son terrain naturel du stade de Veyrier village en synthétique. La dimension du terrain reste globalement inchangée, cependant les exigences des pentes d'un terrain synthétique étant différentes d'un terrain naturel, des modifications des abords sont prévues pour permettre la réalisation de cette transformation, avec une reprise d’une partie des enrobés existants. Une optimisation des clôtures et mains courantes est également prévue par rapport à l'existant, pour permettre d'avoir les buts mobiles au fond du terrain et non plus sur les cheminements à proximité. La présence d'un arbre adjacent au terrain pose des problèmes concernant le pare-ballon existant, obligeant de le laisser sur place, sans modifications possibles. Le terrain synthétique aura une dimension de 106 x 70 m pour une homologation en 1ère ligue, comprenant un marquage principal blanc et deux marquages secondaires bleu et jaune, pour des dimensions de terrain D7 et D9. Un concept de drainage est prévu pour récupérer les eaux de pluie avec la réalisation d'un bassin de rétention d'un volume de 112 m3. Un nouveau système d'arrosage avec 7 arroseurs est également prévu.

title: France – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Solution SaaS - Programmation et optimisation des flux entrants du processus logistique
description: Le centre de services Logistique Industrielle (LI), rattaché à la Direction des Services Supports (DIR2S) d’Enedis souhaite se doter d'une solution SaaS clé en main, permettant la planification, l’optimisation, le pilotage et la traçabilité des flux de livraison en entrée des sites logistiques, au service de la performance opérationnelle des sites logistiques et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Au-delà des fonctions de planification, la solution devra constituer un véritable outil de pilotage de l’activité, en intégrant des capacités avancées d’analyse, de reporting et de valorisation des données. Elle doit permettre une vision consolidée, fiable et exploitable des flux de livraison fournisseur, à la fois à la maille de chaque site logistique et au niveau national, afin de faciliter la prise de décision, l’anticipation des charges et l’amélioration continue des processus. Montant maximum du marché : 869 000 € HT. Le présent marché est mono attributaire. 5 candidats maximum seront retenues pour participer à la phase de consultation. Durée ferme du marché: 3 ans. reconduction : 5 fois un an. La date de début du marché est estimée au : 26/04/2027.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Europese aanbesteding Inhuur personeel
description: ASG wil met deze aanbesteding ASG-breed meer grip krijgen op en sturing geven aan optimale invulling van inhuur. Dit behelst naast kwaliteit ook compliance, kostenbeheersing en goede managementinformatie, wat vraagt om een uitstekende tooling zoals beschreven bij de uitgangspunten en bij de gunningscritetria. De scope is afgebakend op inhuur van: • Bevoegde docenten en leerkrachten; • Onderwijsassistenten; • Ondersteunend personeel (in ieder geval tot schaal 9 schalen hierboven in overleg); • ZZP’ers. Uitgaande van de uitgaven in de laatste twaalf maanden is een jaarlijkse contractwaarde van € 4.000.000 ex BTW reëel. Hier kunnen geen rechten aan worden ontleend. Dit is puur een inschatting op basis van het verleden. Het is onzeker hoe de vraag zich de komende jaren gaat ontwikkelen. ASG streeft naar zoveel mogelijk invulling van de formatie met eigen personeel.

title: ISBEE Solicitation: Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), non-personal healthcare services for Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) services equivalent to two full-time CNMs at Rosebud Service Unit, Rosebud IHS Hospital, Rosebud, South Dakota.
description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION � CERTIFIED NURSE-MIDWIFE SERVICES RFP No. 75H70627R00005 The Indian Health Service (IHS), Great Plains Area, is soliciting proposals for Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), non-personal Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) healthcare services at Rosebud IHS Hospital, Rosebud, South Dakota. This requirement is set aside for Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) under NAICS 561320, Temporary Help Services. The Contractor shall provide qualified CNM personnel sufficient to support two (2) full-time CNM positions providing outpatient obstetric, gynecological, prenatal, postpartum, family planning, and women�s primary care services, as well as obstetric emergency on-call coverage for the Emergency Department. The anticipated contract will use a Firm-Fixed-Price, Month-of-Service (MOS) pricing structure. One MOS represents complete monthly performance of the required CNM services in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS). The anticipated period of performance consists of a three (3)-month base period and three (3) option periods of three (3) months each, for a maximum potential period of performance of twelve (12) months. Services will be performed primarily at Rosebud IHS Hospital, Rosebud, South Dakota. Standard outpatient clinic hours are generally Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The requirement also includes shared 24-hour-per-day, 7-day-per-week CNM on-call availability for obstetric emergencies during non-clinic hours. Offerors shall provide qualified personnel meeting the education, certification, licensure, credentialing, privileging, background investigation, health, and other qualification requirements identified in the PWS. The Government intends to make award to the responsible Offeror whose proposal conforms to the solicitation requirements and represents the best value to the Government, price and other factors considered. Evaluation factors include Technical Capability, Past Performance, Management Approach, and Price. title: Construction of Chilled Water Plant and Site Utility Upgrades at VA Medical Center in West Haven, CT
description: The scope of the chilled water plant replacement consists of the demolition of the existing chilled water plant (building 16a) and construction of a new multi-story chilled water plant to include chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and all associated mechanical and electrical equipment. Due to the close proximity of the existing fuel tank farm adjacent to the existing chilled water plant, a new fuel tank farm will need to be constructed as part of the project, which primarily serves the central boiler plant, requiring close coordination with the medical center and ongoing related projects.The scope of the site utility upgrades consists of the replacement and upgrade of the existing fire protection water main and the domestic water main from Campbell Avenue to Building 15. Site utility upgrades also include providing utility main loops of chilled water supply and return, steam supply, condensate return, domestic water supply, and fire protection water supply which will originate from the new chilled water plant and back-feed to Building 1. The work also includes the installation of redundant electrical feeder from the utility demarcation point to Building 19 and coordination with the local electrical utility provider to provide further electrical redundancy offsite as well. In addition, new water storage tanks will be constructed. This project involves civil/site, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, geotechnical, and architectural disciplines. The project must also comply with the DVAs Physical Security Resiliency Design Requirements (PSRDM). It is expected that the chilled water plant will be constructed to meet USGBC LEED Silver certification. The work is located adjacent to and within an active Medical Center campus which will be operational at all times. Impact to on-going operations must be kept to a minimum and carefully coordinated with the Contracting Officer and VAMC staff. In addition, the work area is constrained due to the active medical center operations which will limit laydown and storage areas during construction.

title: JBMHH Gate Heaters & Fans Supply Rental
description: The Government intends to acquire a contract to provide eight (8) outdoor heaters and eight (8) misting fans, to be exchanged seasonally, for use at the access control points identified in the Specific Tasks section. All units will be operated outdoors and must be suitable for exposure to environmental elements. The Contractor shall provide, emplace, maintain, and recover all equipment. JBMHH will furnish fuel, water, and electricity necessary for operation. The Contractor shall inspect all equipment provided, including ensuring that all electrical cords are adequate and compatible with the required electrical supply. The contractor shall furnish all labor, tools, materials, and technical expertise required to perform diagnostics, repairs, replacements, and stabilization actions. Routine maintenance shall be conducted during standard business hours; however, the contractor must maintain continuous on-call support to respond to critical failures such as electrical hazards, complete equipment shutdown, or conditions that render the gate unsafe or inoperable. All work shall comply with applicable Army, DoD, and installation safety standards, ensuring uninterrupted support to access control operations.

title: Request For Proposal (RFP) NASA Agency-wide Acquisition of Nitrogen and Oxygen 4 (NANO 4)
description: UPDATE - 10/07/2026 The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) John F. Kennedy Space Center is pleased to release the 2027 NASA Agency-wide Acquisition of Nitrogen and Oxygen (NANO) 4 opt-in opportunity as described in the original NANO 4 Request for Proposal (RFP), Sections 2.9, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in, and 2.9.2, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The NANO 4 RFP was issued on March 4, 2024, and the original solicitation (as revised) remains open throughout the ordering period through the use of innovative provisions as prescribed in Section 2, Clause 2.9, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in, and Clause 2.9.2, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The NANO 4 contract�s ordering period remains valid through June 30, 2029. The RFP resulted in the award of six indefinite delivery (ID) fixed price with Economic Price Adjustment (FPEPA) requirements contracts with fixed price delivery orders for the supply of liquid nitrogen and liquid oxygen in support of operations at agency centers and facilities across the United States. NASA made award to the following companies: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc., Airgas USA LLC (Central), Airgas USA LLC (South), Linde, Inc., Nippon Sanso Matheson, Inc. (formerly Matheson Tri-gas, Inc.), and Messer LLC. Each year during the life of the solicitation and at the time established via synopsis, the Government will accept proposals from new entrants for each IDIQ subCLIN location and the Government will also accept proposals from existing NANO 4 contractors for each additional proposed IDIQ subCLIN location. A new entrant does not hold a current NASA liquid nitrogen or liquid oxygen contract. The Government will evaluate the proposals to determine technical acceptability for a specific NASA location. Upon the Government�s determination of technical acceptability, a contract (for new entrants) or contract modification (for existing NANO 4 Contractors) will be executed to add the Contractor to the IDIQ CLIN Pool for the specific NASA location. Thereafter, the Contractor will be eligible to participate in the IDIQ CLIN Pool process described in Section 2.8 for the NASA locations awarded to that Contractor. All eligible Contractors who are awarded an IDIQ subCLIN for a particular NASA location will have the option to compete for requirements within those IDIQ subCLINs which they are awarded. The commodities will support current and future aerospace flight, simulation, research, development, testing, and other operations at the following NASA centers and facilities: Ames Research Center (ARC), Moffett Field, CA 94035; Glenn Research Center (GRC), Cleveland, OH 44135; GRC/Neil A. Armstrong Test Facility (ATF), Sandusky, OH 44870; Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC), Greenbelt, MD 20771; Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), Pasadena, CA 91109; Johnson Space Center (JSC), Houston, TX 77058; Kennedy Space Center (KSC), Kennedy Space Center, FL, 32899; Cape Canaveral Space Force Station (CCSFS), Cape Canaveral, FL, 32920; Langley Research Center (LaRC), Hampton, VA 23666; Marshall Space Flight Center (MSFC), Huntsville, AL, 35812; Michoud Assembly Facility (MAF), New Orleans, LA 70129; Stennis Space Center (SSC), Stennis Space Center, MS, 39529; White Sands Test Facility (WSTF), Las Cruces, NM 88012 and other such places of performance as required in this contract. Submission information: 1. Opt-in by a Current NANO-4 Contractor. A current NANO-4 Contractor shall submit 2027 Attachment 2.1 Capability Form for each proposed IDIQ subCLIN location. The Government will evaluate the capability form to determine technical acceptability in accordance with the weekly maximums for a subCLIN location in RFP Section 2.1.1 Schedule of Supplies Table for Liquid Nitrogen and Liquid Oxygen � Requirements. If the Contractor is determined technically acceptable, award will be made for the subCLIN(s). 2. Opt-in by New Entrant. The new entrant shall submit an Attachment 2.1 Capability Form for each proposed IDIQ subCLIN location. The Government will evaluate the capability form to determine technical acceptability in accordance with the weekly maximums for a subCLIN location in RFP Section 2.1.1 Schedule of Supplies Table for Liquid Nitrogen and Liquid Oxygen � Requirements. Once determined acceptable from a technical standpoint, award will be made for the subCLIN(s). New entrants will be required to comply with the provisions of Section 2.5 of the RFP and all terms and conditions of the resulting contract. 3. All questions regarding this opt-in notice shall be submitted in writing via email to Rose Dougherty at rose.a.dougherty@nasa.gov. The Government will not answer oral questions due to the possibility of misunderstanding or misinterpretation. The Offeror shall submit all questions, if any, no later than October 21, 2026, to allow for analysis and dissemination of responses in advance of the proposal due date. The Government will not guarantee a response to late questions. Questions shall not be directed to technical personnel. 4. All offers shall be sent to Rose Dougherty at rose.a.dougherty@nasa.gov by 4:30PM EST, November 6, 2026. title: Integrated GOTS/NDI Systems and COTS Modular Enablers & Building Blocks
description: The Air Force Research Laboratory, Tech Transition Office AFRL/RR, in coordination with the Information and Spectrum Warfare Directorate (AFRL/RI), is seeking information from industry to improve USAF understanding of domestic market capabilities and identify qualified vendors to collaborate with. Specifically, AFRL is investigating technologies small enough to be installed on Group 2-3 unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) across two core pathways: 1. Integrated GOTS/NDI Systems: Existing Government-Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) or Non- Developmental Item (NDI) radar electronic attack (EA) systems that have been proven or demonstrated for military use. 2. COTS Modular Enablers & Building Blocks: Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) hardware, open software-defined architectures, and high-performance RF components. AFRL is highly interested in innovative commercial building blocks�including Radio Frequency System on Chip (RFSoC) technology, high-speed analog-to-digital converters, and edge compute chips�that can support receive, process, and transmit capabilities in a variety of active and passive military scenarios.

title: Engineering Services for the B-52H Stratofortress
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL/QUOTE. This synopsis is not to be construed as a commitment on the part of the Government to award a contract nor does the Government intend to directly pay for any information or responses submitted as a result of this solicitation. This is a Sources Sought Synopsis; there is no solicitation available at this time. This Sources Sought Synopsis is published for market research purposes only. Companies may be contacted if further information is needed. This announcement constitutes a Sources Sought Synopsis to seek a contractor for future work pertaining to the B-52H engineering services starting 01 January 2028. The Boeing B-52H Stratofortress is an American long-range subsonic jet-powered strategic bomber. The B-52 was designed and built by Boeing, which has continued to provide support and upgrades. It has been operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) since 1955 and was flown by NASA from 1959 to 2007. The bomber can carry up to 70,000 pounds (32,000 kg) of weapons and has a typical combat range of around 8,800 miles (14,200 km) without aerial refueling. The sustainment of the B-52H currently includes the delivery of engineering design, engineering support, and technical support services crucial for the ongoing maintenance and operational readiness of the B-52H aircraft, including its components and associated support and test equipment. The original estimated minimum/maximum amount for the B-52H sustainment contracts was $1.15B over ten (10) years (2019-2028) for engineering services Contract efforts are subject to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.232-18 availability of funds. The sustainment contracts currently contain multiple contract types at the contract line-item level (e.g. firm fixed price, cost plus incentive fee, cost plus fixed fee, etc.) This Sources Sought Synopsis only addresses the B-52H engineering services requirements starting 01 January 2029. The contractor will be required to provide engineering support services that provide technical information and logistics resources to enable maintenance and operational readiness of 76 B-52H aircraft. title: 380 kV, Bonaduz-Sils (GR), remplacement des pylônes avifaune
description:
Les travaux de génie civil comprennent la réalisation ou le renforcement des fondations pour huit emplacements de pylônes. Pour sept pylônes, les fondations existantes seront agrandies, assainies et renforcées au moyen de micropieux. En raison de sa proximité avec un cours d’eau de surface, le pylône 1261x005 sera déplacé d’environ 40 m en direction du pylône 1261x004 et sera doté, à son nouvel emplacement, d’une fondation entièrement nouvelle renforcée au moyen de micropieux. Le pylône 1261x005 sera en outre rehaussé de 4 m et le pylône 1261x019 de 9 m.

L’étendue des prestations comprend notamment les travaux de démolition et de sécurisation nécessaires, l’aménagement des accès au chantier et des voies d’accès temporaires, les travaux d’excavation et de stabilisation des talus, la réalisation de micropieux, les travaux de bétonnage et de fondation, les travaux de mise à la terre ainsi que la remise en état complète des surfaces utilisées. Les montants d’angle des nouveaux pylônes de la ligne seront scellés dans les fondations en béton.

Les travaux seront réalisés en partie dans des zones sensibles du point de vue paysager et écologique ainsi que sur des terrains difficiles d’accès et escarpés. Les prescriptions spécifiques à chaque site concernant la protection de la nature, du paysage, des eaux et des sols, ainsi que les surfaces autorisées pour les accès, les installations de chantier et les travaux, doivent impérativement être respectées lors de l’exécution.


Pour des raisons géographiques, l’appel d’offres relatif aux travaux de génie civil est subdivisé en deux lots, comprenant chacun quatre emplacements de pylônes.


L’étendue détaillée des prestations ainsi que les exigences et les quantités spécifiques au projet figurent dans les documents d’appel d’offres.

title: Planificateur général SIA 32-53 pour la sous-station de Regensdorf
description:
La sous-station de 220 kV de Regensdorf est située dans la commune de Regensdorf, dans le canton de Zurich.


L'installation de commutation de 220 kV à isolation gazeuse de la sous-station de Regensdorf a été mise en service en 2021. Malgré le jeune âge de l'installation à isolation gazeuse (5 ans), celle-ci ne peut pas, selon le fabricant, être étendue avec le même type d'installation. Une pièce d'adaptation fabriquée sur mesure est nécessaire pour pouvoir procéder à l'extension vers un type d'installation actuel. Cela s'accompagne d'un besoin d'espace plus important, raison pour laquelle Swissgrid a décidé d'agrandir directement l'installation de deux baies. À cette fin, l'installation GIS doit être agrandie de deux baies (baie de transformateur et baie de réserve), ainsi que des raccordements de câbles nécessaires.


Le présent appel d'offres vise à recruter le planificateur général pour les phases SIA 32 à 53 afin d'assurer la planification et la coordination de ce projet, les phases SIA 51 à 53 étant attribuées à titre optionnel. Outre l'étendue des prestations spécifiques à son domaine de compétence, le maître d'œuvre assume également la supervision et la coordination générales de tous les domaines spécialisés impliqués, y compris les interfaces associées, en tant que responsable général au sens de la norme SIA 103.


Les sous-projets suivants doivent être organisés par le planificateur général:


  • Direction et coordination de tous les domaines spécialisés impliqués, y compris les interfaces
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le sous-projet - Techniques des circuits primaires
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le sous-projet - Besoins propres
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le sous-projet - Bâtiment et génie civil
  • Direction des trauvaux (facultatif)


Les sous-projets suivants sont mis à la disposition du planificateur général:


  • Coordination générale des modèles BIM
  • Ingénierie et planifcation dans le sous-projet - Système d'automatisation des sous-stations (SAS)
  • Conception et planification dans le sous-projet - Environnement



Pour plus d'informations, veuillez consulter les documents C100 et C101 du dossier d'appel d'offres.

title: Portugal – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Framework contract for EUDA scientific studies support services
description: The purpose of this procurement procedure is to purchase capacity to support the Agency in the preparation of high-quality scientific services and overall to increase the Agency’s timeliness, anticipatory and responsive capacity. The Agency requires access to supporting specialised expertise in the design, conduct, and reporting of different types of scientific work. Outputs may include reports, digital dashboards, AI based tools, methodological and reporting guidelines, training materials, workshops, databases, collection of literature, etc. The present procurement procedure is aimed at supporting the Agency to rapidly mobilise external expertise in a flexible and efficient manner, ensuring responsiveness to evolving scientific priorities and emerging evidence needs. The activities resulting from this procedure are expected to support the EUDA in monitoring drug markets, use of substances and their consequences. They will also help identify the evidence needed to inform responses in terms of establishing trends, examining emerging threats and tracking developments over time and between settings. Ultimately, this is expected to strengthen the preparedness of the Agency, and of the EU as a whole, to respond to drug-related harms.

description: La dispuesta en el artículo 89.1.a) de la Ley 9/2017, de 8 de noviembre, de Contratos del Sector Público, por la que se transponen al ordenamiento jurídico español las Directivas del Parlamento Europeo y del Consejo 2014/23/UE y 2014/24/UE, de 26 de febrero de 2014. La solvencia técnica o profesional se acreditará por el medio que se señala a continuación: relación de los principales suministros realizados de igual o similar naturaleza que los que constituyen el objeto del contrato en el curso de como máximo, los tres últimos años, en la que se indique el importe, la fecha y el destinatario, público o privado de los mismos. Los suministros efectuados se acreditarán mediante certificados expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público; cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por este o, a falta de este certificado, mediante una declaración del empresario acompañado de los documentos obrantes en poder del mismo que acrediten la realización de la prestación; en su caso estos certificados serán comunicados directamente al órgano de contratación por la autoridad competente. Para determinar que un suministro es de igual o similar naturaleza al que constituye el objeto del contrato, en el pliego de cláusulas administrativas particulares se atenderá a los tres primeros dígitos de los respectivos códigos de la CPV.
